abstract: Eighty-seven men with testis cancer (TC) and 35 men with other cancers (OC) completed measures of mood (Profile of Mood States) and of personality and psychopathology (Millon Clinical Multiaxial Inventory). Effects of primary disease, phase of diagnosis and treatment, locoregional vs. cytotoxic treatment, age, and marital status on these measures were examined. TC patients appeared more distressed during treatment, particularly during cytotoxic as compared to locoregional treatment, than before or after treatment, and more distressed than OC patients. Being married appeared to buffer the stress of cancer and its treatment. Although treatment, particularly cytotoxic therapy, appeared to result in transient distress, results did not offer strong evidence that cancer and its treatment typically precipitate severe psychopathology.
abstract_ja: 精巣がん（TC）の男性87例と、他のがん（OC）の男性35例が、気分（Profile of Mood States）ならびに人格と精神病理（Millon Clinical Multiaxial Inventory）の尺度に回答した。原発疾患、診断・治療の時期、局所療法と細胞毒性療法の別、年齢、婚姻状況がこれらの指標に与える影響を検討した。TC患者は治療前後と比べて治療中に強い苦痛を示し、局所療法に比べて細胞毒性療法中にとくに強く、OC患者よりも苦痛が大きかった。既婚であることが、がんとその治療によるストレスを緩和するように見えた。細胞毒性療法を中心に、治療は一過性の苦痛をもたらすように見えたが、がんとその治療が通常、重篤な精神病理を引き起こすという強い証拠は得られなかった。
